payload.comment: Training stage is internally consistent: 15/15 epochs completed, best checkpoint at epoch 15 (val_acc 0.994902), cosine LR schedule decays correctly to 0, config hashes match between best_configuration and the selected trial, selection rule (accuracy-then-macro-F1, 0.005 tolerance) correctly picks res_cnn_wider_d3 over resnet18_deep_d4 (gap 0.0104 > 0.005), test_metrics_used=false confirmed. One cross-artefact inconsistency persists: the preprocessing review comment states augmented_train_size 359984 (89996×4) while split_manifest records 269988 (89996×3). With augmentations [hflip, vflip], 3 copies (original + 2) = 269988 is the arithmetically consistent value, making the ×4 claim in the preprocessing comment erroneous. This is a documentation discrepancy, not a training-correctness fault
llm_issues: Cross-artefact inconsistency: preprocessing review comment asserts augmented_train_size 359984 (89996×4) while split_manifest records 269988 (89996×3); with augmentations [hflip, vflip] the ×3 multiplier (original + 2 augmented copies) is the consistent value, so the preprocessing comment's ×4 is incorrect
